summary: Audited inventory for T1 item 2 (Layout (analog partition)): 5 routed analog GDS (differential_driver, differential_receiver, dplus_pullup, se_receiver_dm, se_receiver_dp) and the generator sidecar layout/analog/provenance.json, each stream listed with its sha256 alongside the layout plan and SPICE netlist it was built from. Every block is fully routed (routing_method accounts for all of its nets) and DRC-clean in the sidecar, which records the klt drc run made at delivery. Every member file is listed with its sha256 and signoff/check.py re-derives the inventory from the live tree, so the bound hash proves the inventory is current and the member hashes prove the files it describes are. It does not run a simulation, a synthesis or a flow, and re-derives no measured value. Gates that need xschem, the gf180mcu PDK, yosys or OpenROAD are not run by signoff/check.py or by the PDK-free CI job; they are named in the inventory, not claimed as having run. It asserts only that the routed analog streams exist, still hash to the values layout/analog/provenance.json recorded for them, and were DRC-clean when delivered. Byte-level regeneration is a separate gate (scripts/gen_analog_layout.py --check) that needs klt and the PDK and is run neither here nor in CI, so this envelope does not assert that regenerating a stream reproduces its committed bytes -- see verification/records/analog-layout/ for what that gate last measured. It does NOT claim LVS, ERC or extracted re-simulation of the analog partition, and makes no area, matching or timing claim.
